_about: Source of truth for the GameShuffle shop (curated packs; TCGplayer stays the place for singles). This tracked copy is the one the app and scripts/seed-shop.ts read; docs/specs/shop/ is gitignored. The seed script creates Stripe Products and Prices (test mode) and shop_products rows from this file. Postage and dates are config, not code, maintained by Britton. Weights are estimates until a packed unit is weighed; update them here.

checkout._blocked_states: Stripe's US address form lists the Armed Forces codes and the territories as states; orders to them are refunded (50 states and DC only).

shipping._rule: Every order ships tracked by USPS Ground Advantage (Britton, 2026-10-09): $4.99 under $25, free at $25 and up (subtotal before tax). stamped_mail false switches off the letter and flat methods below; set it true to bring them back (1 single = letter, 2 to flat_max_singles = flat).

postage_cents._source: USPS retail prices effective July 12, 2026. Confirm values marked confirm in Phase 0.

shipping._no_ship_days: USPS holidays (and any day Britton won't ship) inside the shop window; the ship-by date skips them and weekends.

holiday._usps_recommended: Ground Advantage and First-Class Mail by Thu Dec 17 (lower 48), Wed Dec 16 (Alaska and Hawaii)

contact._confirm: Britton to confirm the shop's support email and the return address for envelopes.

returns._rule: Britton, 2026-10-09: Pokémon card products are final sale; no returns because of which Pikachu or hit is in a pack. Damage in transit and missing guaranteed contents are still made right.
